title: Fix badge visibility at top and bottom

requirements.text: Resize the SSL Protected badge container at the top of the page to display the full badge without cutoff

quotes: first of all, fix the badges at top and also at the bottom

acceptanceCriteria: SSL Protected badge at top is fully visible without any portion being cut off
Badge container height accommodates the complete badge image
Badge maintains proper aspect ratio and image quality

requirements.text: Resize the Quality/Verified badge container at the top of the page to display the full badge without cutoff

quotes: first of all, fix the badges at top and also at the bottom

acceptanceCriteria: Quality badge at top is fully visible without any portion being cut off
Badge container height accommodates the complete badge image
Badge maintains proper alignment with other top badges

requirements.text: Resize all badge containers at the bottom of the page (footer area) to display badges with full visibility

quotes: first of all, fix the badges at top and also at the bottom

acceptanceCriteria: All footer badges are fully visible without cutoff
Badge containers properly sized to show complete badge images
Badges maintain consistent spacing and alignment in footer

constraints: Do not change the backend schema or product data logic
Maintain existing badge image assets and positioning structure
Preserve the current visual hierarchy and layout flow
nonGoals: Fixing the product loading error (to be addressed separately)
Modifying badge designs or replacing badge images
Changing the overall page layout or color scheme
